fusions.name: Wear Them Down
fusions.desc: A shove that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds, with a 35% chance to leave it [Fatigued] for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each ally near you, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Driven Into the Weave
fusions.desc: A crushing drive that deals 26 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaves each [Slowed] for 5 seconds. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Staked Calf
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Worth the Wait
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina is full, your next spell deals 25% more damage. Once every 10 seconds.
